scripts.build:h5: vite build && node -e "const{cpSync,rmSync,readdirSync,existsSync,mkdirSync}=require('fs');const{join}=require('path');const src='static';const dist='dist/static';if(!existsSync(dist))mkdirSync(dist,{recursive:true});readdirSync(src).forEach(f=>{const sp=join(src,f);const dp=join(dist,f);rmSync(dp,{recursive:true,force:true});cpSync(sp,dp,{recursive:true,force:true})});rmSync('dist/build',{recursive:true,force:true});if(existsSync('functions')){const fd='dist/functions';rmSync(fd,{recursive:true,force:true});cpSync('functions',fd,{recursive:true,force:true})}console.log('[postbuild] done')"
